UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile storing the user's preferred Arabic display name and last active edition preference.

uid.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User-chosen Arabic display name shown as author of their study edition.

lastActiveEditionId.description: Optional identifier of the last viewed edition (original or an author uid).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

StudyEdition.title: StudyEdition
StudyEdition.description: A user's personalized overlay edition of the Maarij al-Qabul study guide (edits, deletions, additions for Sharh and Question Bank) that can optionally be shared publicly.

uid.description: Owner user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Public author name displayed on this shared/personal edition.

bio.description: Optional short description of this user's study edition.

isPublic.description: Whether this edition is visible for other learners to browse.

revision.description: Monotonically non-decreasing revision counter for offline sync tracking.

topicOverrides.description: Map keyed by topicId containing edits, deletions, and additions for topics, Matn, and Sharh sub-elements.

questionOverrides.description: Map keyed by questionId containing edits or soft-deletes for canonical Question Bank items.

addedQuestions.description: List of custom solved questions added by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the edition was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the edition was last updated.

/users/{uid}.description: Private user metadata document strictly accessible only by its owner.

/editions/{uid}.description: Per-user study guide overlay edition; writable only by owner and readable by owner or publicly when isPublic is true.
